# Material Symbols

Solstice's icons are Google's **Material Symbols** (Rounded):

- Unfilled icons come from the **Symbols** library (`io.github.hlcaptain:symbols-material-vectors-rounded`,
  <https://github.com/HLCaptain/symbols>), Apache License 2.0.
- Filled icons (`app/src/main/kotlin/org/breezyweather/ui/expressive/components/FilledSymbols.kt`)
  are path data copied from Google's material-design-icons repository
  (<https://github.com/google/material-design-icons>, `symbols/android/<name>/materialsymbolsrounded/
  <name>_fill1_24px.xml`), downloaded 2026-11-19, because the library's filled vectors draw some
  glyphs hollow.

Material Symbols are © Google, licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(<https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0>).
